spans.s: [mama and mamama, nt., read amama, q.v.]

mamāyati, ˚te (denom. to mama; = Pali ˚ti; Skt. once ˚te, Mbh 〔12.8051〕, where it means cherishes as here, wrongly BR), cherishes; esp. with kelāyati, q.v. (as with keḷ˚ in Pali), so in LV 〔100.9〕; AsP 〔254.2〕 ˚yeyur; Dbh 〔39.23〕 (here mamāyitāni, foll. by dhanāyitāni niketasthānāni), all cited s.v. kelāyati; yasya nāsti mamāyitam Ud 〔xxxii.18(17)〕; na mamāyamāno, not cherishing (as oneʼs own), Bimbisārasūtra, Waldschmidt, Kl. Skt. Texte 4, 〔125.10〕; labdhā (read ˚dhvā, probably) lābhaṃ na mamāyate na dhanāyate na saṃnidhiṃ karoti Śikṣ 〔269.6〕, does not hoard; in LV 〔374.5〕 (vs) Lefm. mamiyita, understood as ppp. to this verb, but read manyanāś with v.l.
Māmakī, n. of a Buddhist goddess: Mvy 〔4275〕; Dharmas 〔4〕; Mmk 〔41.5〕; Sādh 〔18.14〕 etc.
